set(OPENDAQ_ENABLE_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OPENDAQ_GENERATE_C_BINDINGS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(DAQMODULES_OPENDAQ_CLIENT_MODULE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DAQMODULES_OPENDAQ_SERVER_MODULE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OPENDAQ_ENABLE_NATIVE_STREAMING ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(DAQMODULES_REF_DEVICE_MODULE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DAQMODULES_REF_FB_MODULE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DAQMODULES_REF_FB_MODULE_ENABLE_RENDERER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	
FetchContent_Declare(
    openDAQ
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/openDAQ/openDAQ.git
    GIT_TAG main
    GIT_PROGRESS   ON
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(openDAQ)
